high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from the Instagram Explore feed, featuring a post by Forbes. The post includes a photograph of a woman with curly blonde hair, wearing a bright green leather jacket over a white top. She has a confident expression and is standing against a dark background. The text overlay on the image reads: "How A Former PR Executive Built A $500 Million Brand Around Cauliflower Pizza Crust." This suggests that the post is about Gail Becker, the founder and CEO of Caulipower, a company that has successfully created a brand around cauliflower pizza crusts.
